title: Quote: It's kind of like watching the gladiator going into the aren...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: The Birth of the Mac: Rolling Stone's 1984 Feature on Steve Jobs and his Whiz Kids
content: It's kind of like watching the gladiator going into the arena and saying, 'Here it is.' It's really perceived as Apple's do or die. And it goes even deeper... If we don't do this, nobody can stop IBM.
full_transcript: It's kind of like watching the gladiator going into the arena and saying, 'Here it is.' It's really perceived as Apple's do or die. And it goes even deeper... If we don't do this, nobody can stop IBM.
